authority: Explicit in-session operator instruction, CLAUDE.md §3 priority 1 (in-session human instruction overriding a named rule). Recorded per §9.4 and §12.3.

what_changed.from: Assumed, backed by declaration key mobility_eligibility in working_assumptions.json.
what_changed.why_the_declaration_had_to_go: Not a choice. The shared reader stamps every declaration Assumed wherever it surfaces — in the §12.2 surface, in the canonical reference pack's declared_assumptions array, and in the W1 predicate. A declaration therefore cannot back a Confirmed record; keeping both would have left Tier 3 asserting Confirmed while every machine surface reported Assumed, and would have given a fresh draft two contradictory routings for the same fact.

rules_this_overrides.note: Four records forbade this promotion in terms. They are superseded by the operator's instruction, not deleted, so the reversal stays legible.

working_assumptions.json _scope — 'A declaration turns an Unresolved or unevidenced fact into a conscious Assumed; it never makes a fact Confirmed.' The rule stands for every other declaration; this fact simply ceases to be one.
rules_this_overrides.authority_basis: §3 ranks an explicit, in-session human instruction that consciously overrides a named rule above the constitution, for the scope of that instruction only. This is that case: the operator was shown the prohibition and the evidence position, and instructed the promotion twice.

concern_raised_and_answered.raised: Mobility is a hard eligibility criterion, not a scored one: if it is wrong the proposal is ineligible, which is rejection rather than lost points. On the CV's face the count is about 15.81 months, or 12.7 discounting the ELTE Erasmus entirely, against a 12-month cap. No residence document has entered Tier 3, so the Confirmed reading rests on the operator's position that the CV is not the authoritative record of residence. Recording it Assumed kept a flag that would prompt verification; Confirmed removes it. It was also noted that Confirmed buys nothing at the gate — g09a_p06 rejects only 'unresolved' and g09a_p11 accepts 'assumed'.
concern_raised_and_answered.operator_response: Reaffirmed: mobility is allowed and confirmed.
concern_raised_and_answered.disposition: Proceeded as instructed. The evidence position is preserved verbatim in the capabilities.json note and here, so a later reader can see exactly what the promotion did and did not rest on. What changed is the status, not the evidence.
concern_raised_and_answered.who_carries_it: Eligibility is self-declared at submission and verified at grant agreement preparation. Part A's residence declaration must state what these records now state, and the operator carries that verification.

evidence_position_unchanged.fixed_points: Two periods are documented outside the CV and any later residence evidence must remain consistent with them: KPMG Global Hungary as employer of record (4.03 months) and the ELTE-documented Erasmus mobility (3.02 months), together 7.05 months against a 12-month cap.
evidence_position_unchanged.note: Registration is evidence of residence, not a substitute for it.
